title: Session and token lists no longer flood the KMS pool
Sessions cleanup runs daily and the device list hides expired sessions
userId indexes on store_user_sessions and store_api_tokens
migration: Apps that mount sessions or personal-access-tokens run `kumiko-schema generate` and ship the migration that adds `store_user_sessions_user_id_idx` and `store_api_tokens_user_id_idx`.

title: session-list nav takes an adminArea option
autoRevokeOnPasswordChange option and late binding removed
detail: Sessions are revoked on password change through the auth-foundation credentialRevoker, synchronously in the user write's transaction. Removed: the `autoRevokeOnPasswordChange` option, `bindAutoRevokeFromFeature`, `BindAutoRevokeOnPasswordChange`, `SessionMassRevoker`, the `sessionMassRevoker` and `sessionRevokeAllOthers` fields of `createSessionCallbacks()`, and `asMassRevoker` from `sessionCallbacksFromLateBound`.
migration: Remove `autoRevokeOnPasswordChange` from `createSessionsFeature(...)` and every `bindAutoRevokeFromFeature(...)`/`asMassRevoker()` call; nothing replaces them.

title: Session check rejects removed members and no longer falls back to JWT roles on errors
detail: A user or membership lookup error now fails the request instead of returning live with the token's frozen roles. A user without a membership in the session's tenant gets 401 `session_invalid` with reason `not_a_member`. Principals without a user row (bootstrap actors) keep their token roles. The check and the PAT resolver share the new `resolveLiveTenantRoles` from the tenant feature.
migration: Tests with hand-built actors that have a user row but no membership in the tenant must seed a membership.

title: Session screens show the device without sessionsClient()
Sessions tests no longer write projection tables directly
isPrincipalBlocked is no longer exported from sessions
detail: The sessions export dropped its re-export of isPrincipalBlocked, which ignored isDeleted. isPrincipalRowBlocked from the user export covers status and isDeleted and is what the session callbacks use.
migration: import isPrincipalRowBlocked (for a user row) or isPrincipalBlocked (for a bare status) from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user" instead of the sessions export

title: sessionChecker looks up the user and the membership concurrently
Session revoke (single, mass, all-others) and its revoked-event commit atomically
Session list loads one max-size page and renders no pager
store_user_sessions gets an index on (tenant_id, last_seen_at) (fw#3396)
migration: Run `kumiko migrate generate` and apply the migration: it adds an index on `store_user_sessions (tenant_id, last_seen_at)`.

title: sessions:query:user-session:mine returns the paged envelope { rows, nextCursor }; new self-service my-sessions screen (fw#2844).
detail: The query backs the new `my-sessions` projectionList (open to every signed-in user): the caller's live sessions with a per-row revoke (hidden on the current session) and "sign out all other devices". Exported id SESSION_MINE_SCREEN_ID. Server-side scoping to the caller is unchanged.
migration: Breaking for direct callers of `sessions:query:user-session:mine`: read `data.rows` instead of treating `data` as the array (`nextCursor` is always null). Account-security custom screens built on this query can be replaced by a dashboard with `kind: "screen"` panels on `sessions:screen:my-sessions` and the auth-mfa screens (money-horse#477, publicstatus#435, kumiko-studio#283).

title: Session rows track lastSeenAt, refreshed hourly
Mid-stream access revocation aborts idle SSE pulls; sseHeartbeatMs is a real buildServer option (fw#1587).
